_comment: 'If a Draconic attack was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again.' The card PRINTS GoAgain and the engine applies a printed keyword unconditionally, so the gate was decoration. loader.conditional_keywords() strips it only for a SOURCE_IS_ATTACK-gated grant, which is why a TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK version did not work. Copied from grow_wings_blue, same printed text, already verified. WHILE_STATIC because CR 6.2.3d evaluates a conditional static-continuous effect at all times, not once.
